features.title: Flatten live positions when a run halts
features.scenario: A run leaving RUNNING closes its open positions, so a halt never leaves exposure on the book.
features.description: Adds `flattenRunPositions`, which takes the position lock before it reads what is open.

entities.name: Position
entities.summary: A holding a run has opened.

diagrams.title: Halt flow
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A[Run leaves RUNNING] --> B[flattenRunPositions]
  B --> C[broker.close]

features.tested: Unit tests for the flatten loop.

features.title: Expose POST /api/runs/:id/flatten
features.scenario: An operator flattens a run by hand.
features.description: A route that calls `flattenRunPositions`, and a page on what flattening does.

features.title: Pack view hides closed positions
features.scenario: A learner sees only what is still held.
